restated: An adversary with access to Windows hosts on this network stole credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: Observable evidence such as LSASS process access or memory dumps, suspicious use of credential-dumping tools (e.g., Mimikatz, ProcDump, comsvcs.dll), access to SAM/SECURITY/SYSTEM registry hives or NTDS.dit, Kerberoasting or AS-REP roasting attempts, or anomalous authentication using stolen credentials from compromised Windows hosts.
what_would_refute: Observable absence of credential theft indicators on the compromised Windows hosts, including no LSASS access or memory dumping, no credential-dump tool execution, no unauthorized access to credential stores or registry hives, and no authentication or privilege escalation activity attributable to stolen credentials.
